title: Bilirubin synthesis, conjugation and canalicular transport
guide: Daily bilirubin production of 4 mg/kg, 80% hemoglobin and 20% heme sources, HOX-1 versus HOX-2, biliverdin reductase, albumin binding, passive sinusoidal uptake, glutathione transferase, rate-limiting UGT conjugation, active MRP-2 canalicular export, and MRP-3 bilirubin hopping with OATP1B1/B3 Rotor and Dubin-Johnson syndromes.

title: Bilirubin excretion, urobilinogen dynamics and LFT fractions
guide: Biliary excretion, bacterial deconjugation at the ileocecal junction, 80% fecal stercobilinogen versus 20% enterohepatic urobilinogen, urine urobilinogen patterns (traces normal, high in extravascular hemolysis, absent in obstruction, escape in cirrhosis), total and direct/indirect bilirubin values by HPLC, and hepatic disease progression.

title: Hyperbilirubinemia taxonomy and ALT versus AST properties
guide: Indirect hyperbilirubinemia >= 85% with Gilbert (30% activity) and Crigler-Najjar II (<10% activity), direct hyperbilirubinemia >= 50%, normal ALT values (<23 in males, <19 in females), reticuloendothelial AST clearance, cytoplasmic versus mitochondrial localization, PLP co-factor, and prodromal acute hepatitis transaminitis.

title: Transaminitis severity, alcoholic hepatitis ratios and diagnostic patterns
guide: Severe acute transaminitis >1000 U/L in viral, ischemic, toxic hepatitis and acute duct obstruction, alcoholic hepatitis (300-500 U/L, AST>ALT due to PLP requirement, 2:1 and 3:1 diagnostic ratios), chronic hepatitis mild elevations (<150 U/L), cirrhosis sinusoidal AST retention, and isolated AST non-hepatic elevations.

title: Alkaline phosphatase, cholestasis evaluation and delta bilirubin
guide: ALP normal (40-140 U/L) and cholestasis threshold (>560 U/L), zinc displacement in Wilson's disease, canalicular, bone, intestinal, renal, and placental sources, GGT liver-specificity, ultrasound duct dilation algorithm, pruritus pathophysiology, and delta bilirubin covalent binding with 14-21 day half-life.

title: Drug-induced cholestasis, albumin kinetics and coagulation panel
guide: Bland, cholestatic, granulomatous, and vanishing bile duct syndromes, albumin synthesis (15 g/day, T1/2 14-21 days, MW 69,000 Da) and negative acute-phase behavior, monoclonal versus polyclonal A/G reversal, and the definitive DIC versus FHF coagulation table (D-dimer, FDP, fibrinogen, Factor VIII).

title: Prognostic acute INR and liver stiffness elastography
guide: Acute INR >= 1.5 indicating poor prognosis in fulminant hepatic failure, FibroScan transient elastography separating NASH from cirrhosis at 7.5 kPa, and MR elastography as the gold-standard diagnostic tool.
